description: Portfolio frontend experience - Immersive project showcase with dynamic grid, hover previews, category filtering, smooth transitions, project detail view, and integration with backend API.
steps: Create packages/frontend/src/components/portfolio/PortfolioSection.tsx - Main portfolio section for homepage: section heading, category filter bar, dynamic project grid. Fetches projects from backend API (GET /api/projects?status=published) with loading state. Falls back to demo/placeholder projects if API unavailable

Create packages/frontend/src/components/portfolio/CategoryFilter.tsx - Horizontal scrollable filter bar with category buttons (All, Branding, Web, Motion, 3D, Production). Active category highlighted with animated underline/pill. Smooth filter transition when category changes (items animate out/in with stagger)

Create packages/frontend/src/components/portfolio/ProjectGrid.tsx - Dynamic masonry-style grid layout using CSS Grid with variable item sizes (span 1 or 2 columns, variable heights based on image aspect ratio). Featured projects are larger. Grid reflows smoothly when filters change. Uses CSS containment for performance

Create packages/frontend/src/components/portfolio/ProjectCard.tsx - Individual project card: large image with lazy loading (next/image), project title, category badge, year. Hover interaction: image scales subtly (1.02), overlay appears with project description excerpt, cursor changes to custom pointer. Entire card is a link to project detail. Includes smooth transition for enter/exit hover states

Create packages/frontend/src/components/portfolio/ProjectPreview.tsx - On hover (desktop) or long-press (mobile): expanded preview overlay showing larger image, title, description, and 'View Project' button. Positioned near cursor. Animated entrance (scale + fade from cursor position). Exits smoothly on mouse leave
Create packages/frontend/src/app/work/page.tsx - Full portfolio page with all projects, larger grid, additional filters, and sort options (newest, oldest, category)

Create packages/frontend/src/app/work/[slug]/page.tsx - Individual project detail page: full-width hero image, project title, client name, date, category, description, technology tags, image gallery, external project link button. Previous/Next project navigation. Smooth page transition (image morphs from grid position to full-width hero position if possible, otherwise elegant fade-in)

Create packages/frontend/src/components/portfolio/ProjectGallery.tsx - Image gallery for project detail: lightbox-style fullscreen image viewer, thumbnail strip, keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Escape to close), swipe on mobile, smooth transitions between images

Create packages/frontend/src/lib/api.ts - API client utility: base URL configuration (env-based), typed fetch wrapper with error handling for GET/POST/PUT/DELETE, handles auth token for admin requests, returns typed responses matching shared types

Create placeholder demo projects data in packages/frontend/src/data/demoProjects.ts - 6 sample projects with placeholder images (use picsum.photos or colored gradient placeholders), realistic titles and descriptions for a creative studio portfolio
Ensure portfolio grid degrades gracefully on mobile (single column, horizontal scroll option for categories)
acceptance_criteria: Portfolio section fetches and displays projects from backend API
Falls back to demo projects gracefully when API is unavailable
Category filter works with smooth animated transitions between filtered states
Project cards have interactive hover states with image scale and overlay
Dynamic grid uses variable sizes (not all cards same size)
Project detail page shows all project information with image gallery
Image gallery supports keyboard navigation and touch gestures
Lazy loading works for project images (visible in Network tab)
Portfolio is fully responsive across all breakpoints
Previous/Next navigation works on project detail pages
verification: Run npm run build from root and confirm frontend compiles without errors
Start both frontend and backend dev servers
Verify portfolio section renders with demo projects on homepage
Verify category filter transitions and project detail page routing works
findings: fs_write tool writes to snapshot layer not visible to bash/build. Used bash heredocs for all file creation. Build passes with all routes recognized. framer-motion AnimatePresence used for filter transitions. next/image configured with picsum.photos remote patterns.
